scope: canonical 16K, 6 GiB pool, CUDA Graph ON, 100 warmup + 100 measured tokens
interpretation: Promotion timing is measured inside the promotion routine; overlap and later compute savings make it non-additive with whole-token wall time.
T0 already pays one packed route readback and scheduler synchronization per token.
T1-T4 add fragmented expert-slice transfers, map updates, and cache replacement work.
Higher hit rate did not translate into higher end-to-end throughput on this implementation.

nsight_systems.note: Two short collections observed target exit while the collector stayed active; lightweight runtime instrumentation is the attribution source.
